title: Field signal → prescription with scored review
description: Normalize mixed field data onto one canonical vocabulary, build the prescription, and gate machine release on a scored teacher review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-agri-01
  title: Field signal → prescription with scored review
  description: Normalize mixed field data onto one canonical vocabulary, build the prescription, and gate
    machine release on a scored teacher review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release a variable-rate prescription that is agronomically justified, legal at every point
    in the field, and executable by the machine it is written for.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Field layers and crop context
      summary: Field layers and crop context
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - imagery_layers
              - soil_tests
              - yield_history
              - machine_profile
            properties:
              imagery_layers: {}
              soil_tests: {}
              yield_history: {}
              machine_profile: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-normalize
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize to the canonical vocabulary
      summary: 'rename source layer fields onto the canonical vocabulary: field_id, zone, crop_stage,
        measured_index, target_rate'
      config:
        operation: rename
        expression: 'rename source layer fields onto the canonical vocabulary: field_id, zone, crop_stage,
          measured_index, target_rate'
    - id: n-specialist
      kind: agent
      templateRef: agri-03
      name: Build the variable-rate prescription
      summary: Specialist pass over normalized fields.
      role: Precision-agriculture planner turning zone maps into machine-ready prescriptions.
      prompt: You are a Precision Application Planner. You build management zones and variable-rate prescriptions
        from yield, soil, and imagery layers, and you validate that the prescription is executable by
        the machine and legal at every point in the field. You keep buffer, waterway, and setback geometry
        inside the prescription rather than leaving it to the operator, because a prescription that requires
        manual override will be overridden inconsistently.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:farm-management
          - mcp:gis
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-score
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Scored teacher feedback
      summary: Score feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: You are the review teacher for this prescription. Score it on agronomic justification per
        zone, label and buffer compliance at every point, and machine executability. Return per-zone scores
        and name the specific zone and reason behind every deduction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: score
    - id: n-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the specialist result
      summary: Evaluate agronomic justification, label and buffer compliance, and machine executability.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against agronomic justification, label and buffer compliance,
        and machine executability. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-pass
      kind: condition
      name: Above the bar?
      summary: Route on gate.passed.
      config:
        expression: gate.passed
        branches:
          - label: Pass
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: agri-01
      name: Correct the flagged zones
      summary: Corrective pass on the scored weaknesses.
      role: Agronomist converting field, soil, and weather evidence into management decisions.
      prompt: You are an Agronomic Decision Analyst. You combine soil tests, crop stage, weather, and
        field history into specific management recommendations with rates, timings, and the agronomic
        reasoning attached. You state label, buffer, and re-entry constraints on every product recommendation,
        and you decline to recommend a rate the label does not support regardless of what the agronomic
        model suggests.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:farm-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Agronomist sign-off before the prescription goes to the machine
      summary: Pause for the supervising agronomist; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Field signal → prescription with scored review deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-normalize
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-2
      from: n-normalize
      to: n-specialist
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-3
      from: n-specialist
      to: n-score
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-4
      from: n-score
      to: n-gate
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-5
      from: n-gate
      to: n-pass
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-6
      from: n-pass
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-7
      from: n-pass
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-8
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-agri-01-edge-9
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
